blocks.explanation:
Fraction proper hai aur neeche mila jula case hai: \((x - 1)\) ek dafa (Case I) aur \((x + 1)\) do dafa (Case II).
Humein teen fractions chahiyein.
Plan: identity, \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) rakhna, aakhri constant \(x^2\) ke coefficients se, aur jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{4x}{(x + 1)^2(x - 1)}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Akele factor ko ek fraction milta hai; repeated factor \((x + 1)^2\) ko do, power 1 aur power 2 ke liye. Imtihan mein aise mile jule sawal bohat aate hain.

Check karein ke fraction proper hai
Upar degree 1, neeche degree 3.
Kyun: \(1 < 3\), is liye division nahi chahiye.

Shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{4x}{(x + 1)^2(x - 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 1)^2}\]
Kyun: \((x - 1)\) ka ek fraction, \((x + 1)^2\) ke do. Total teen constants, aur neeche ki degree bhi 3 hai; constants ki ginti hamesha denominator ki degree ke barabar hoti hai. Yeh ek achha check hai ke shakal poori likhi hai.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[4x = A(x + 1)^2 + B(x - 1)(x + 1)\]
\[+ C(x - 1) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x + 1)^2(x - 1)\) se multiply kiya. \(B\) ke neeche sirf ek \((x + 1)\) tha, is liye us ke saath \((x - 1)(x + 1)\) bacha.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[4 = A(2)^2\]
\[A = 1\]
Kyun: \(x - 1 = 0\), to \(B\) aur \(C\) dono terms khatam.

\(C\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[-4 = C(-2)\]
\[C = 2\]
Kyun: \(x + 1 = 0\), to \(A\) aur \(B\) dono terms khatam. Baayen taraf \(4(-1) = -4\).

\(B\) ke liye coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ A + B = 0\]
\[B = -1\]
\[\text{const}:\ A - B - C = 1 + 1 - 2 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Baayen taraf \(4x\) mein na \(x^2\) hai na constant. \(x^2\) daayen taraf sirf \(A(x + 1)^2\) aur \(B(x - 1)(x + 1)\) se aata hai.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\((x - 1)(x + 1)^2\) par numerator:
\[(x + 1)^2 - (x - 1)(x + 1) + 2(x - 1)\]
\[= x^2 + 2x + 1 - x^2 + 1 + 2x - 2\]
\[= 4x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jor kar numerator \(4x\) hi bana, yani teenon constants sahi hain. Common denominator mein \((x + 1)\) ki sab se oonchi power, yani \((x + 1)^2\), lete hain; \((x + 1)^3\) lene ki zaroorat nahi. Dhyan dein ke \(-(x^2 - 1) = -x^2 + 1\); bracket ke aage minus poore bracket ke signs badal deta hai.
